info.title: UponAI Platform API
info.description: Programmatic control plane for configuring UponAI agents, LLM configurations, conversation flows, knowledge bases, calls, chats, voices, and test tooling. All endpoints require a bearer token obtained from your profile settings.

tags.name: Calls
tags.description: Initiate and manage UponAI powered voice and web calls.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Configure agents that power calls and web sessions.

tags.name: LLM Models
tags.description: Manage reusable large language model configurations for agents.

tags.name: Chat Agents
tags.description: Configure agents for browser and messaging chat sessions.

tags.name: Chats
tags.description: Start and manage live chat sessions.

tags.name: Conversation Flows
tags.description: Build and maintain reusable dialog graphs for agents.

tags.name: Knowledge Bases
tags.description: Store and curate grounded knowledge sources.

tags.name: Voices
tags.description: Discover, search, add, and clone speech synthesis voices.

tags.name: Test Case Definitions
tags.description: Define simulation test cases for response engines.

tags.name: Test Runs
tags.description: Retrieve results for individual and batch test runs.

tags.name: Phone Numbers
tags.description: List and assign phone numbers to agents.

post.description: Initiate a PSTN phone call via UponAI infrastructure. The workspace is inferred from the unique agentId. You may still send workspaceId for backward compatibility. Native-transfer workspaces expose the full per-call override surface, including agentOverride, overrideAgentVersion, customSipHeaders, and ignoreE164Validation.

post.description: Start a browser based call session powered by an UponAI agent. The workspace is inferred from the unique agentId. You may still send workspaceId for backward compatibility.

get.description: List calls with optional workspace, agent, status, and date filters.
Return paginated call history for a single workspace, including agent and workspace metadata plus optional search and date filters.

parameters.name: agentVersion
parameters.description: Filter call history to a specific persisted agent version captured at call time.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by call SID, phone number, platform call ID, customer name, or agent name.

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.description: When true, include archived calls in the response.

parameters.name: includeChildCalls
parameters.description: When true, include child calls linked to transfer or split-call workflows.
